items.title: Music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation: a narrative review of clinical applications, proposed mechanisms, and implementation.
items.summary: A narrative review on music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation found consistent evidence for rhythmic auditory stimulation in gait and music-supported upper-limb programs, with potential for melodic intonation therapy in nonfluent aphasia, but highlights inconsistent terminology and overstated mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 本综述明确了音乐干预在卒中康复中的应用边界和证据强度。对步态障碍应优先考虑节律性听觉刺激（RAS），上肢功能可考虑音乐支持项目，但其他应用证据尚不充分，尤其是需要警惕夸大的机制阐释。
items.titleZh: 成人卒中康复中的音乐干预：临床应用、作用机制和实施的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于成人卒中康复中音乐干预的叙述性综述显示，节律性听觉刺激对步态、音乐辅助上肢训练的证据最一致，旋律语调疗法对非流畅性失语症有潜力，但该领域术语不一且存在夸大机制的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clarifies the scope and evidence strength of music-based interventions in stroke rehabilitation. Prioritize rhythmic auditory stimulation (RAS) for gait, and consider music-supported programs for upper limb function. Be cautious of overblown claims about mechanisms, as evidence for other applications remains insufficient.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，未进行正式的偏倚风险评估和定量汇总，可能存在选择性偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, this study did not conduct formal risk-of-bias assessment or quantitative pooling, which may introduce selection bias.

items.title: Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970-1990: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative descriptive study explored the development of Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970 to 1990, identifying the significance of the Repetitive Strain Injury (RSI) epidemic, ineffective medical responses, barriers in conventional physiotherapy education, and the profession's adaptability.
items.curatedReason: 回顾 1970-1990 年澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展，你会发现 RSI 流行病和随后的立法改革是塑造该专业早期面貌的关键转折点。这篇定性研究提示我们，应对新兴职业健康挑战时，传统教育的局限性与专业适应性同样重要。
items.titleZh: 1970-1990 年澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 1970 至 1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展，发现重复性劳损 (RSI) 流行病、医疗反应不足、传统教育障碍以及专业适应性是关键影响因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Looking back at the 1970-1990 development of Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy, you'll see the RSI epidemic and subsequent legislative reforms were pivotal in shaping the profession's early landscape. This qualitative study suggests that, when confronting emerging occupational health challenges, the limitations of traditional education and the profession's adaptability are equally critical.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性回顾，结果基于特定时期的少数受访者叙述，可能存在回忆偏倚和样本代表性局限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative retrospective study's findings are based on narratives from a limited number of interviewees during a specific period, potentially subject to recall bias and sampling limitations.

items.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of an Integrated Treatment of Vestibular Rehabilitation and Cognitive Behavior Therapy for Chronic Dizziness in a Community-Based Population: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded RCT (n=105) found no statistically significant between-group differences in dizziness-related handicap or gait speed at 6 or 12 months when comparing integrated vestibular rehabilitation and cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) with a brief vestibular intervention (BI-VR) in community-based adults with chronic dizziness.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性头晕患者，整合前庭康复和认知行为疗法的团体干预（VR-CBT）在改善头晕相关障碍方面，与单次前庭干预（BI-VR）相比，未显示出额外的统计学显著优势。临床上继续单独使用前庭康复即可，无需急于整合 CBT。
items.titleZh: 社区慢性头晕患者前庭康复与认知行为疗法整合治疗有效性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照试验（n=105）显示，与简短前庭干预（BI-VR）相比，整合前庭康复和认知行为策略（VR-CBT）在社区慢性头晕成年人中，在 6 或 12 个月时，头晕相关障碍或步态速度方面未显示统计学显著组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic dizziness patients, a group intervention integrating vestibular rehabilitation and cognitive behavioral therapy (VR-CBT) did not show statistically significant additional benefits in improving dizziness-related handicap compared to a single-session brief vestibular intervention (BI-VR). Clinicians can continue to use vestibular rehabilitation independently without urgent integration of CBT.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 105 人，可能不足以检测出干预组与对照组之间的小到中等效应差异。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size of 105 participants might be insufficient to detect small to moderate effect differences between the intervention and control groups.

items.title: Balancing Offloading and Comfort: The Effect of Forefoot Rocker Curvature on In-Shoe Plantar Pressure and Gait Kinematics
items.summary: A study in 10 healthy adults found that a straight-line rocker profile (CRi) significantly reduced metatarsal head pressure (mean pressure=80 kPa) compared to curved rockers, but was perceived as least comfortable and affected ankle dorsiflexion. Rocker curvature is a key design parameter for therapeutic footwear.
items.curatedReason: 不同前足弧度摇椅鞋底对足底压力和步态生物力学的影响不同。虽然直线型摇椅鞋底在跖骨头处减压效果最好，但牺牲了踝关节运动范围和舒适度。临床上选择摇椅鞋时，需要根据患者具体需求平衡减压与舒适性。
items.titleZh: 平衡减压与舒适：前足摇椅弧度对鞋内足底压力和步态运动学的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名健康成年人的研究发现，直线型摇椅鞋底（CRi）在跖骨头处显著降低压力（平均压力=80 kPa），但舒适度最低并影响踝关节背屈。摇椅弧度是治疗性鞋具设计的关键参数。
items.curatedReasonEn: Different forefoot rocker curvatures in rocker-soled footwear impact plantar pressure and gait biomechanics differently. While a straight-line rocker optimizes offloading at the metatarsal heads, it compromises ankle range of motion and comfort. Clinicians should balance offloading with comfort based on individual patient needs when prescribing rocker shoes.
items.limitation: 研究仅纳入了 10 名健康成人，结果的临床外推性可能有限，无法直接应用于高风险糖尿病足溃疡患者。
items.limitationEn: The study only included 10 healthy adults, which may limit the clinical generalizability of the results to high-risk individuals with diabetic foot ulceration.

items.summary: A long-term follow-up study examined the timing of rehabilitation after mild traumatic brain injury, with limited details provided in the abstract regarding specific findings or methodology.

items.summaryZh: 一项长期随访研究探讨了轻度颅脑损伤后康复时机的影响，但摘要中未提供具体的发现或方法学细节。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article discusses long-term follow-up on the timing of rehabilitation after mild traumatic brain injury. However, neither the abstract nor the full text provides specific study design details, sample size, or key numerical findings, offering insufficient information for clinical decision-making.

items.title: Novel Telerehabilitation Interventions for Stress Urinary Incontinence : A Systematic Review of Randomised Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 13 RCTs found telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) for stress urinary incontinence (SUI) to be safe, feasible, and effective, with comparable clinical outcomes and higher adherence versus passive controls, and comparable efficacy to conventional care.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述发现，远程盆底肌训练（PFMT）在主观症状改善和生活质量方面与传统面对面物理治疗效果相当，且能提高依从性和可及性。这意味着远程交付的 PFMT 是应对压力性尿失禁的安全、可行和有效替代方案。
items.titleZh: 压力性尿失禁新型远程康复干预：随机对照试验系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 13 项 RCT 的系统综述显示，远程康复交付的盆底肌训练 (PFMT) 在治疗压力性尿失禁 (SUI) 方面是安全、可行且有效的，与被动对照组相比，临床结局相当且依从性更高，与传统护理相比，疗效相当。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review finds telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) to be comparable to traditional in-person PT for subjective symptom improvement and quality of life, while also enhancing adherence and accessibility. This positions telerehab PFMT as a safe, feasible, and effective alternative for stress urinary incontinence.
items.limitation: 研究间存在显著的方法学和临床异质性，因此结果采用叙述性综合而非荟萃分析，可能影响结论的普适性。
items.limitationEn: Significant methodological and clinical heterogeneity across studies led to narrative synthesis rather than meta-analysis, which may impact the generalizability of findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of a multicomponent exercise programme including high-intensity interval training in institutionalised older adults with probable sarcopenia: a multicentre randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A 12-week multicomponent exercise program including high-intensity interval training (HIIT) significantly improved handgrip strength (mean difference: 9.11 [7.70 to 10.51]) and physical performance (SPPB mean difference: 3.75 [2.93 to 4.56]) in 92 institutionalized older adults with probable sarcopenia, with NNT of 2 for both.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心 RCT 明确显示，在养老机构老年衰弱患者中，包含高强度间歇训练（HIIT）的 12 周多组分运动方案可显著改善握力、身体表现，且 NNT 值低（NNT=2），效果显著。这为你设计机构内老年康复项目，尤其是针对肌少症患者，提供了强有力的证据支持。
items.titleZh: 针对养老机构内可能患肌少症老年人的多组分运动方案（含高强度间歇训练）效果：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 12 周的多组分运动方案，包括高强度间歇训练 (HIIT)，显著改善了 92 名养老机构内可能患肌少症老年人的握力（平均差值：9.11 [7.70 至 10.51]）和身体表现（SPPB 平均差值：3.75 [2.93 至 4.56]），两项指标的 NNT 均为 2。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter RCT clearly shows that a 12-week multicomponent exercise program including high-intensity interval training (HIIT) significantly improves handgrip strength and physical performance in institutionalized older adults with sarcopenia, with a low NNT (NNT=2) indicating substantial effect. This provides strong evidence to support your design of in-facility geriatric rehabilitation programs, especially for sarcopenic patients.
items.limitation: 该研究追溯性注册试验，可能存在未报告的方案变更。
items.limitationEn: The trial was retrospectively registered, which may imply unreported protocol changes.

items.title: Isolated anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction versus reconstruction with a lateral extra-articular procedure (LET or ALL reconstruction): a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis compared isolated anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction with combined ACL reconstruction and a lateral extra-articular procedure (LET or ALL), providing insights into re-rupture rates and rotational stability.
items.curatedReason: 对于年轻且有高风险因素的患者，ACL 重建时联合侧方关节外辅助重建（LET 或 ALL）能显著降低再次撕裂率。临床决策时，应考虑将这种联合手术作为标准方案，特别是在重视旋转稳定性的情况下。
items.titleZh: 孤立性前交叉韧带重建与联合侧方关节外手术（LET 或 ALL 重建）：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析比较了孤立性前交叉韧带 (ACL) 重建与联合 ACL 重建和侧方关节外手术（LET 或 ALL），为再撕裂率和旋转稳定性提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: For young, high-risk patients, combining ACL reconstruction with a lateral extra-articular procedure (LET or ALL) significantly reduces re-rupture rates. You should consider this combined surgery as a standard option in clinical decision-making, especially when rotational stability is a key concern.
items.limitation: 研究正文未提供具体数据和效应量，导致无法对结论强度进行精确评估。
items.limitationEn: The full text of the study does not provide specific data and effect sizes, preventing a precise evaluation of the strength of the conclusions.

items.title: Lumbar MRI findings in the recumbent and the upright position: a prospective observational study on type and frequency of differences by direct comparison
items.summary: A prospective observational study directly compared lumbar MRI findings in recumbent and upright positions, identifying differences in the type and frequency of pathological findings, with dural sac compression more prevalent in the upright position.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性观察研究表明，腰椎 MRI 在仰卧位和站立位时影像学表现存在差异，其中硬膜囊受压的诊断在站立位更常见。这提示你，评估腰痛患者时，如果影像学和临床表现不符，直立位 MRI 可能提供更准确的结构信息。
items.titleZh: 仰卧位和站立位腰椎 MRI 发现：一项关于差异类型和频率的直接比较前瞻性观察研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究直接比较了仰卧位和站立位腰椎 MRI 结果，发现病理学结果的类型和频率存在差异，其中硬膜囊受压在站立位更为普遍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective observational study reveals differences in lumbar MRI findings between recumbent and upright positions, with dural sac compression more frequently diagnosed in the upright position. This suggests that if imaging and clinical presentation mismatch in lumbar pain patients, an upright MRI might offer more accurate structural information.
items.limitation: 研究正文未提供具体的样本量和差异频率，限制了对发现的量化理解。
items.limitationEn: The study's full text does not provide specific sample sizes or frequency of differences, which limits the quantitative understanding of the findings.

items.title: Be Prepared! Why Payer Changes Can Upend Billing Practices If You’re Not Ready
items.summary: This article advises physical therapy practices to be proactive in managing continuous changes in payer procedures and guidelines to maintain compliance, recommending appointing a point person, subscribing to updates, keeping records, and setting up billing software alerts.
items.curatedReason: 支付方政策变动是常态，我们必须主动管理才能保持合规。诊所管理者应指定专人负责追踪、订阅政策更新、详细记录变动，并利用计费软件的提醒功能。这样做是避免索赔被拒和回款延误的关键，不是可有可无的。
items.titleZh: 做好准备！若不未雨绸缪，支付方政策变化可能颠覆你的计费实践
items.summaryZh: 本文建议物理治疗诊所应积极主动地管理支付方程序和指南的持续变化，以保持合规性，并建议指定专人负责、订阅更新、保留记录并设置计费软件提醒。
items.curatedReasonEn: Payer policy changes are constant; you must proactively manage them to stay compliant. As a clinic manager, you should designate a point person to track changes, subscribe to updates, meticulously document policy shifts, and leverage billing software alerts. This isn't optional; it's critical for avoiding denied claims and delayed payments.

items.title: Ten-year outcomes of medical cannabis for chronic low back pain: opioid reduction, pain relief, and functional improvement in 1,000 patients
items.summary: A 10-year longitudinal observational study of 1,000 chronic low back pain patients reported medical cannabis use was associated with reduced opioid consumption, pain relief, and functional improvement, with clinically meaningful outcomes observed.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示医用大麻可能在慢性腰痛患者中减少阿片类药物使用、缓解疼痛和改善功能。但在临床实践中，目前尚无足够的证据支持医用大麻作为物理治疗的常规替代或辅助。
items.titleZh: 医用大麻治疗慢性腰痛的十年结局：1000 名患者的阿片类药物减少、疼痛缓解和功能改善
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 1000 名慢性腰痛患者的十年纵向观察性研究报告，医用大麻的使用与阿片类药物消耗减少、疼痛缓解和功能改善相关，并观察到临床有意义的结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests medical cannabis may reduce opioid use, alleviate pain, and improve function in patients with chronic low back pain. However, there isn't yet sufficient evidence to support its routine use as a substitute or adjunct to physical therapy in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心观察性研究，且涉及医疗大麻这种有争议的干预，其长期疗效和安全性仍需更高质量的证据支持。
items.limitationEn: As a single-center observational study involving a controversial intervention like medical cannabis, higher quality evidence is needed to confirm its long-term efficacy and safety.

items.title: Facility-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation Intervention Package (PRIP) for individuals with post-tuberculosis lung disease (PTLD) in Odisha, India: A quasi-experimental study protocol
items.summary: This is a quasi-experimental study protocol for a facility-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation Intervention Package (PRIP) for individuals with post-tuberculosis lung disease (PTLD) in Odisha, India, aiming to evaluate its effectiveness.
items.curatedReason: 这项只是研究方案，目前没有实际证据。不过，如果该方案（在印度）能成功实施并证明对肺结核后肺病（PTLD）患者有效，将为发展中国家特有的肺部疾病康复提供一个潜在的、可复制的模式。
items.titleZh: 印度奥里萨邦肺结核后肺病（PTLD）患者基于机构的肺康复干预包（PRIP）：一项准实验性研究方案
items.summaryZh: 这是一项针对印度奥里萨邦肺结核后肺病 (PTLD) 患者的基于机构的肺康复干预包 (PRIP) 的准实验性研究方案，旨在评估其有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is merely a study protocol, so there is no actual evidence yet. However, if this proposed intervention in India proves effective for post-tuberculosis lung disease (PTLD) patients, it could offer a replicable model for rehabilitation of specific lung conditions in developing countries.

items.title: Home-based digital exercise versus hospital physiotherapy for plantar fasciitis: a propensity-score-matched retrospective cohort study with dual-perspective cost-utility evaluation.
items.summary: A propensity-score-matched retrospective cohort study (N=587) in China found a 12-week home-based digital exercise program for plantar fasciitis was non-inferior to hospital physiotherapy for 3-month first-step morning pain and less costly from both payer (-¥4,920) and societal (-¥7,008) perspectives.
items.curatedReason: 这项中国单中心回顾性研究提示，家庭数字运动方案治疗跖筋膜炎在3个月时，相对于医院物理治疗在首步晨痛方面呈现非劣效，且成本更低。对于PT执业者来说，这为远程数字康复提供了初步的经济效益证据，但仍需等待更高质量的RCT来支持广泛的政策采纳和报销。
items.titleZh: 居家数字运动与医院物理治疗治疗跖筋膜炎：一项双重视角成本效益评估的倾向得分匹配回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项中国的倾向得分匹配回顾性队列研究（N=587）发现，为期12周的居家数字运动方案在3个月时，治疗跖筋膜炎的首步晨痛方面非劣于医院物理治疗，且从支付方（-¥4,920）和社会（-¥7,008）角度看成本更低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This single-center retrospective study from China suggests that a home-based digital exercise program for plantar fasciitis is non-inferior to hospital physiotherapy in terms of first-step morning pain at 3 months, and is less costly. For PT practitioners, this offers preliminary evidence of the economic benefits of remote digital rehabilitation, but higher-quality RCTs are needed to support widespread policy adoption and reimbursement.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，尽管进行了倾向得分匹配，但仍有潜在的残余混杂和选择偏倚，且仅6.3%的患者符合匹配条件，限制了结果的外推性。此外，结果来自中国单一中心，数据适用性有局限。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study. Despite propensity-score matching, potential residual confounding and selection bias exist, and only 6.3% of screened patients were eligible, limiting generalizability. Furthermore, the results are from a single center in China, limiting data applicability.

items.title: Effects of High-Intensity Laser Therapy on Functional Outcomes and Spasticity-Related Pain in Subacute and Chronic Stroke Patients with Plantar Flexor Spasticity: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (N=22) found high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) significantly reduced spasticity-related pain (P<0.001) in subacute/chronic stroke patients, with a smaller covariate-adjusted gait benefit, when combined with conventional rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 高强度激光治疗（HILT）作为卒中康复的辅助手段，在缓解痉挛相关疼痛方面表现出显著且持久的效应，但在改善步态速度上的临床意义尚不明确。将其作为疼痛管理选项是合理的，但步态改善仍需主动训练。
items.titleZh: 高强度激光治疗对亚急性和慢性卒中患者跖屈肌痉挛相关疼痛和功能结局的影响：一项随机假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（N=22）显示，高强度激光治疗（HILT）联合常规康复，能显著减轻亚急性和慢性卒中患者的痉挛相关疼痛（P<0.001），并带来较小的、经协变量调整后的步态改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-intensity laser therapy (HILT) as an adjunct to stroke rehabilitation significantly and durably reduces spasticity-related pain, though its clinical significance for gait speed improvement remains uncertain. It's a reasonable option for pain management, but active training is still needed for gait improvement.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的小样本（N=22）单中心研究，结果需要更大规模的试验来确认其临床实践意义。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary, small-sample (N=22), single-center study, and its findings require confirmation in larger trials to determine clinical practice implications.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Physical dependence, self-efficacy, and resilience in stroke patients: a double-moderated mediation model of healthcare group and pre-stroke employment.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (N=123) found self-efficacy mediated the relationship between physical dependence and resilience in stroke patients. This conditional indirect pathway was significant primarily in the routine care group among patients unemployed pre-stroke, suggesting social and vocational factors influence psychosocial adaptation.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，卒中患者的自我效能感部分介导了躯体依赖与复原力之间的关系。对于卒中前失业且接受常规护理的患者，这种间接关联尤为显著，强调了在康复策略中考虑患者社会角色和就业史的重要性。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者的躯体依赖、自我效能和复原力：医疗组别和卒中前就业的双重调节中介模型
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究（N=123）发现，自我效能介导了卒中患者躯体依赖与复原力之间的关系。这种有条件的中介路径在卒中前失业且接受常规护理的患者中尤为显著，提示社会和职业因素影响心理社会适应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that self-efficacy partially mediates the relationship between physical dependence and resilience in stroke patients. This indirect pathway is particularly pronounced in patients who were unemployed pre-stroke and received routine care, underscoring the importance of considering social role and employment history in rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小（N=123），结果可能受限于特定医院环境和中国文化背景，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional observational study, unable to establish causality, with a small sample size (N=123). Results may be limited to the specific hospital environment and Chinese cultural context, with limited generalizability.

items.title: Effects of Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training and physical therapy on gait quality in children with cerebral palsy: A severity-stratified analysis.
items.summary: Lokomat-based RAGT combined with PT induces severity-dependent and joint-specific kinematic improvements in children with CP, detected by instrumented gait analysis, but GMFM-88 total score may be less sensitive to these gait-specific changes over 4 weeks.
items.curatedReason: Lokomat 辅助步态训练可改善脑瘫儿童步态，但 GMFM-88 总分可能无法反映 4 周内的步态细节变化，解读时需谨慎。
items.titleZh: Lokomat辅助机器人辅助步态训练与物理治疗对脑瘫患儿步态质量的影响：一项严重程度分层分析
items.titleEn: Effects of Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training and physical therapy on gait quality in children with cerebral palsy: A severity-stratified analysis
items.summaryZh: Lokomat辅助机器人训练结合物理治疗可改善脑瘫（CP）患儿的步态运动学，且改善程度与患儿运动障碍严重程度（GMFCS分级）相关。然而，在4周内，GMFM-88总分可能不如步态分析指标对步态特异性变化敏感。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective observational study on Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training in children with cerebral palsy found severity-dependent, joint-specific kinematic improvements. However, the study acknowledges that the GMFM-88 total score was less sensitive to gait-specific changes over 4 weeks, suggesting careful interpretation of gross motor function improvements.
items.limitation: Retrospective observational design with a specific GMFCS level population.
items.limitationEn: Retrospective observational design with a specific GMFCS level population.

items.title: Study Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Swiss Ball Balance Training and Conventional Balance Training to Improve Trunk Control and Mobility in Individuals with Sub acute Stroke.
items.summary: This protocol for a randomized controlled trial will compare Swiss ball balance training with conventional balance training in individuals with subacute stroke, assessing trunk control, balance, and mobility.
items.curatedReason: 虽然 Swiss 球平衡训练对比常规训练在急性期卒中患者中的研究设计看似合理，但该 RCT 仍处于方案阶段，无需参考。
items.titleZh: 一项旨在改善恢复期卒中患者躯干控制和活动能力的瑞士球平衡训练与常规平衡训练比较的随机对照试验研究方案
items.titleEn: Study Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Swiss Ball Balance Training and Conventional Balance Training to Improve Trunk Control and Mobility in Individuals with Sub acute Stroke
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案将开展一项随机对照试验，比较瑞士球平衡训练与常规平衡训练对恢复期卒中患者躯干控制、平衡和活动能力的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study protocol outlines a randomized controlled trial comparing Swiss ball balance training to conventional balance training for subacute stroke survivors. While the concept is promising, the study is in its protocol phase, and results are not yet available. The inclusion of a specific geographical focus (Sub-Saharan Africa) adds context but doesn't change the generalizability of the findings at this stage.
items.limitation: Study protocol stage, results not yet available.
items.limitationEn: Study protocol stage, results not yet available.

items.title: Effect of Sequential Electroacupuncture Combined With Augmented Reality Gait Training on Walking Function and Neuromuscular Control in Subacute Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT of 40 subacute stroke patients found sequential electroacupuncture (EA) plus augmented reality (AR) gait training improved gait speed (primary outcome) and other functional measures significantly more than AR alone over 4 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 与单独使用增强现实（AR）步态训练相比，顺序电针联合 AR 步态训练在亚急性卒中患者中显著改善了步速（主要结局）、步长、步态对称性、运动功能和平衡。这一组合疗法为神经康复提供了一个有前景的策略。
items.titleZh: 顺序电针联合增强现实步态训练对亚急性卒中患者行走功能和神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.titleEn: Effect of Sequential Electroacupuncture Combined With Augmented Reality Gait Training on Walking Function and Neuromuscular Control in Subacute Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 40 名亚急性卒中患者的单盲 RCT 研究发现，连续 4 周的电针（EA）联合增强现实（AR）步态训练，相比单独 AR 训练，在提高步速（主要结局）、步长、步态对称性、FMA-LE、BBS 和 CCI 方面均有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sequential electroacupuncture combined with AR gait training significantly improved gait speed (primary outcome), stride length, gait symmetry, motor function, and balance in subacute stroke patients compared to AR training alone. This combination therapy offers a promising strategy for neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: The study had a relatively small sample size (n=40) and a follow-up duration of 4 weeks, which may limit the generalizability of the findings on long-term effects.
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (n=40) and a follow-up duration of 4 weeks, which may limit the generalizability of the findings on long-term effects.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Adaptive Sports Introduction During Inpatient Rehabilitation: A Descriptive Study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study surveyed 100 inpatients with new disabilities; 43% desired exposure to adaptive sports (AdS) during rehabilitation. Younger age, pre-admission sports participation, and current AdS exposure correlated with this desire.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究表明，在住院康复期间引入适应性运动（AdS）能满足新近残疾患者的需求，尤其是年轻患者和曾参与体育活动的患者。多学科团队应考虑在康复早期提供 AdS 暴露机会。
items.titleZh: 住院康复期间的适应性运动介绍：一项描述性研究。
items.titleEn: Adaptive Sports Introduction During Inpatient Rehabilitation: A Descriptive Study.
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名新近残疾住院患者的横断面调查显示，43% 的患者希望在康复期间接触适应性运动（AdS）。年轻、有既往运动史以及目前接触 AdS 的患者更渴望体验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study indicates that introducing adaptive sports (AdS) during inpatient rehabilitation meets the needs of patients with new disabilities, particularly younger individuals and those with prior sports participation. Multidisciplinary teams should consider offering AdS exposure early in the rehabilitation phase.
items.limitation: The study is cross-sectional and relies on self-reported data, which may not capture all nuances of patient interest or exposure.
items.limitationEn: The study is cross-sectional and relies on self-reported data, which may not capture all nuances of patient interest or exposure.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Quantitative evaluation of shoulder motor compensation in stroke patients based on multimodal feature analysis.
items.summary: A study integrating markerless motion capture with surface electromyography (sEMG) to objectively assess shoulder motor compensation in 25 stroke patients found strong correlations between multimodal features (e.g., Maximum Joint Angle ρ = 0.932, Median Frequency ρ = 0.806) and traditional clinical scales.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提出的无标记运动捕捉与表面肌电图结合的肩关节运动补偿量化评估方法，为中风患者上肢功能康复评估提供了客观、简化的补充工具。在临床实践中，它可以作为 Fugl-Meyer 评估等主观量表以外的有效参考。
items.titleZh: 基于多模态特征分析的中风患者肩关节运动补偿量化评估
items.summaryZh: 一项结合无标记运动捕捉和表面肌电图的研究，对 25 名中风患者的肩关节运动补偿进行了客观评估，发现多模态特征（如最大关节角度 ρ = 0.932，中位频率 ρ = 0.806）与传统临床量表之间存在强相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study's quantitative evaluation method for shoulder motor compensation, integrating markerless motion capture and sEMG, offers an objective and simplified complementary tool for assessing upper-limb function in stroke patients. In clinical practice, it can serve as a valuable reference alongside subjective scales like the Fugl-Meyer Assessment.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本观察研究，且仅限肩关节外展任务，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample observational study, limited to a single shoulder abduction task, so results should be interpreted with caution regarding generalizability.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Tailoring Resistance Exercise for Knee Osteoarthritis: An Intervention Systematic Review With Dose-Response Meta-analysis of the Effects of Intensity and Volume.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 20 RCTs (n=791) found that isotonic resistance training may improve pain, function, and strength in knee OA patients. Very light to moderate intensity for pain, moderate intensity for function, and moderate to vigorous for strength showed benefits. Dose-response analyses suggested peak pain reduction at 6000 repetitions (MD -3.52), functional improvement at 2600 repetitions (MD -16.66), and maximal strength gains at 1600 repetitions (SMD 0.12).
items.curatedReason: 针对膝关节骨关节炎，中等强度等张抗阻训练以及特定重复次数（如疼痛改善需 6000 次，功能改善需 2600 次，力量增强需 1600 次）可能带来最大效益。这份证据有助于你在处方抗阻训练时更精细地设定参数。
items.titleZh: 膝关节骨关节炎抗阻运动的个体化：一项强度和容量剂量-反应 Meta 分析的干预系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 20 项 RCT（n=791）的系统综述及剂量-反应 Meta 分析显示，等张抗阻训练可改善膝关节骨关节炎患者的疼痛、功能和力量。剂量-反应分析提示，疼痛改善可能在 6000 次重复训练时最佳（MD -3.52），功能改善在 2600 次中等强度重复训练时最佳（MD -16.66），力量最大增益在 1600 次重复训练时（SMD 0.12）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For knee osteoarthritis, moderate-intensity isotonic resistance training with specific repetition volumes (e.g., 6000 for pain, 2600 for function, 1600 for strength) may yield the greatest benefits. This evidence helps refine your resistance training prescriptions by providing more precise parameters.
items.limitation: 证据确定性为低至极低，提示结果仍需更高质量研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence is low to very low, indicating that the results require validation from higher-quality studies.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: The Efficacy of Exercise Therapy for Nonspecific Chronic Low Back Pain According to the FITT Principle: A Systematic Review With Meta-analyses.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 70 RCTs (n=3991) found that high-frequency exercise programs (≥3 sessions/week) significantly improved long-term disability in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain (SMD 0.29). Sensorimotor, yoga, and assisted exercises showed modest short-term or long-term benefits for disability compared to other modalities, though with low certainty of evidence and lack of clinically meaningful effects.
items.curatedReason: 非特异性慢性腰痛患者的运动处方，优先考虑每周 3 次及以上的高频率。尽管特定运动类型（如感觉运动、瑜伽）可能带来额外益处，但幅度有限且证据确定性低，因此在FITT原则中，最应优先的仍是患者偏好、依从性和可行性。
items.titleZh: 根据 FITT 原则，运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛的疗效：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 70 项 RCT（n=3991）的系统综述和 Meta 分析显示，高频率（每周 ≥3 次）运动方案能显著改善非特异性慢性腰痛患者的长期残疾（SMD 0.29）。感觉运动、瑜伽和辅助运动相比其他模式可能带来轻微额外益处，但证据确定性较低且临床意义有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with non-specific chronic low back pain, prioritize high-frequency exercise programs (≥3 sessions per week). While certain exercise types (e.g., sensorimotor, yoga) might offer modest additional benefits, their effect size is limited and certainty of evidence is low. Therefore, patient preferences, feasibility, and long-term adherence should remain the primary considerations in FITT principle application.
items.limitation: 特定运动类型的临床意义有限且证据确定性低，可能受异质性影响。
items.limitationEn: The clinical significance of specific exercise types is limited, and the certainty of evidence is low, potentially affected by heterogeneity.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Proximal and Distal Bimanual Motor Skill Learning After Stroke: Impairments, Trajectories, and Clinical Contributors
items.summary: A randomized trial with 97 (sub)acute stroke patients found improvements in accuracy and coordination on both distal and proximal bimanual tasks over three days, though less than healthy individuals. Most patients with mild-to-moderate impairment exhibited substantial residual bimanual motor learning capacity early after stroke, with baseline motor and attentional impairments predicting outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，大部分轻中度卒中患者在早期仍保留双侧运动学习能力，提示个体化双侧康复策略结合运动和认知需求可能有效。在设计早期干预时，关注患者的基线运动和注意力缺陷。
items.titleZh: 卒中后近端和远端双侧运动技能学习：损伤、轨迹和临床影响因素
items.summaryZh: 一项对97名（亚）急性卒中患者进行的随机试验发现，在三天内，患者在远端和近端双侧任务上的准确性和协调性均有改善，但不如健康对照组。大多数轻中度受损患者在卒中早期表现出显著的残余双侧运动学习能力，基线运动和注意力缺陷是预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that most mild-to-moderate stroke patients retain substantial bimanual motor learning capacity early after stroke, indicating that individualized bimanual rehabilitation strategies integrating both motor and cognitive demands may be effective. Focus on baseline motor and attentional impairments when designing early interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项在急性期和亚急性期卒中患者中进行的随机试验，研究结果可能不完全适用于慢性期患者，且报告为预印本，未经同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This is a randomized trial conducted in acute and subacute stroke patients; findings may not be fully applicable to chronic patients, and it is a preprint, not yet peer-reviewed.

items.title: Addressing stroke family caregivers' mental health through person‑ and family‑centred rehabilitation.
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes literature on stroke family caregiver experiences and support needs, highlighting person- and family-centred care (PFCC) as a potential approach to address gaps in caregiver support and mental health. Caregivers are at increased risk of adverse mental health outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本综述强调卒中康复应将照护者视为团队关键成员，并提供持续的教育、培训和支持。在制定康复计划时，考虑以个体和家庭为中心的照护模式。
items.titleZh: 通过以个体和家庭为中心的康复解决卒中家庭照护者的心理健康问题
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了卒中家庭照护者的经验和支持需求文献，强调以个体和家庭为中心的照护（PFCC）作为解决照护者支持和心理健康方面差距的潜在方法。照护者面临不良心理健康结局的风险增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review emphasizes that stroke rehabilitation should recognize caregivers as key team members and provide ongoing education, training, and support. Consider person- and family-centred care models when developing rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性证据综合。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may have selection bias and does not involve systematic evidence synthesis.

items.title: Associations of ankle strength and range of motion with reactive strength performance in elite youth soccer players
items.summary: This observational study investigates the associations of ankle strength and range of motion with reactive strength performance in elite youth soccer players. The findings suggest a relationship between ankle function and athletic performance in this specific population.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，脚踝力量和活动度可能与青少年精英足球运动员的反应性力量表现有关。在评估和训练这类运动员时，应将脚踝功能纳入考虑，以优化表现和预防损伤。
items.titleZh: 踝关节力量和活动度与精英青少年足球运动员反应性力量表现的关系
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性研究调查了精英青少年足球运动员踝关节力量和活动度与反应性力量表现之间的关联。研究结果表明，在这个特定人群中，踝关节功能与运动表现存在相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that ankle strength and range of motion may be associated with reactive strength performance in elite youth soccer players. Incorporate ankle function into assessment and training for these athletes to optimize performance and prevent injuries.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且研究对象仅限于青少年精英足球运动员，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study that cannot establish causality, and the study population is limited to elite youth soccer players, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Evidence-Based Insights for the Development and Talent Promotion of Young Athletes in a National Sports Context
items.summary: This perspective article explores evidence-based insights for the development and talent promotion of young athletes, using the Swedish context as a starting point. It discusses challenges and opportunities in balancing early talent promotion with more inclusive, long-term athlete development models.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了青少年运动员发展和人才培养中基于证据的见解，虽然主要聚焦瑞典背景，但对于理解如何在平衡高水平竞技和长期健康发展之间取得平衡，仍有通用参考价值。在培养年轻运动员时，应考虑更全面的发展模式。
items.titleZh: 国家体育背景下青少年运动员发展和人才培养的循证见解
items.summaryZh: 这篇视角文章以瑞典背景为起点，探讨了青少年运动员发展和人才培养的循证见解。文章讨论了在早期人才培养与更具包容性的长期运动员发展模式之间取得平衡的挑战和机遇。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights evidence-based insights for youth athlete development and talent promotion. While focused on Sweden, it offers generalizable insights into balancing high-performance sport with long-term healthy development. Consider more holistic development models when training young athletes.
items.limitation: 这是一篇专家述评，主要基于瑞典的特定背景，其结论的证据等级低于实证研究，且普适性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert commentary primarily based on the specific context of Sweden, and its conclusions have a lower level of evidence than empirical research, with limited generalizability.

items.title: Motor Module-Guided Human-Machine Interaction Promotes Improvement of Neuromuscular Coordination and Reduction in Motor Impairment in Chronic Stroke: A Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study with 5 chronic stroke survivors showed that a 6-week motor module-guided intervention improved neuromuscular coordination and motor impairment, with gains maintained at 1 and 3 months. This was in contrast to a force-guided control group.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，以运动模块为导向的康复训练可能有效改善慢性卒中患者的神经肌肉协调性，并减轻运动障碍。这是一个新的干预思路，值得关注其后续的高质量研究。
items.titleZh: 运动模块引导的人机交互在慢性卒中中促进神经肌肉协调改善和运动障碍减轻：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 5 名慢性卒中患者的初步研究显示，为期 6 周的运动模块引导干预改善了神经肌肉协调性和运动障碍，并在 1 个月和 3 个月后仍保持效果。这与力量引导对照组的结果形成对比。
items.curatedReasonEn: Motor module-guided intervention appears superior to force-guided for chronic stroke. This small study suggests a promising new direction, but don't jump the gun on implementation; wait for higher-quality evidence to confirm efficacy.
items.limitation: 这是一项样本量极小的初步研究（仅 5 例干预组），且研究设计为试点研究，无法得出确切的临床推荐。
items.limitationEn: This is a very small pilot study (only 5 in the intervention group), limiting the generalizability and definitive clinical recommendations.

items.title: Determining the optimal volume of reactive balance training after stroke: a pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A three-arm pilot RCT with 36 sub-acute stroke survivors found that reactive balance training (RBT) intervention and assessment procedures were feasible, with high adherence across 1, 3, or 6 RBT sessions. Falls as a primary outcome for a definitive single-site trial were not feasible, suggesting stability-based outcomes for future trials.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 告诉你，对亚急性卒中患者实施 RBT 是可行的，且 36 名患者对 1、3 或 6 次 RBT 的依从性都很高。但要记住，在今后的临床试验中，别再把跌倒作为主要结局指标了，应聚焦于平衡稳定性。
items.titleZh: 确定卒中后反应性平衡训练的最佳剂量：一项初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项涉及 36 名亚急性卒中患者的三臂初步随机对照试验发现，反应性平衡训练 (RBT) 的干预和评估程序可行，在 1、3 或 6 次 RBT 训练中依从性很高。以跌倒作为确定性单中心试验的主要结局并不可行，提示未来试验可采用基于稳定性的结局指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT tells you that RBT is feasible for sub-acute stroke survivors, with 36 participants showing high adherence to 1, 3, or 6 sessions. Crucially, don't use falls as a primary outcome in future trials; focus on stability-based measures instead.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点研究，主要目标是评估可行性，而非确定疗效或最佳剂量，因此无法得出关于最佳训练量的确切结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study, primarily assessing feasibility rather than efficacy or optimal dosage, thus no definitive conclusions on optimal training volume can be drawn.

items.title: Muscle work during manual wheelchair propulsion in people with a spinal cord injury: a model-based approach.
items.summary: A model-based study evaluated individual muscle contributions, including rotator cuff muscles, to mechanical work during wheelchair propulsion in five individuals with spinal cord injury, finding that the supraspinatus showed no mechanical work and overall rotator cuff contributions were lower than previously reported.
items.curatedReason: 这项模型研究精准描绘了截瘫患者轮椅推进中各肌肉（特别是肩袖肌群）的实际做功贡献。这对你调整训练重点、优化推进策略和设计预防过劳伤的干预措施有直接指导意义。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者手动轮椅推进过程中的肌肉做功：一项基于模型的分析
items.summaryZh: 一项基于模型的分析评估了五名脊髓损伤患者在手动轮椅推进时各肌肉（包括肩袖肌群）的机械做功贡献，发现冈上肌无机械做功，且肩袖肌群的总体贡献低于此前报道。
items.curatedReasonEn: This model-based study precisely maps the actual work contribution of individual muscles (especially rotator cuff muscles) during wheelchair propulsion in individuals with paraplegia. This directly informs your training focus, propulsion strategy optimization, and interventions to prevent overuse injuries.
items.limitation: 该研究基于少数截瘫患者的实验数据进行建模，其结果外推性有限，且模型无法完全捕捉生物力学复杂性。
items.limitationEn: The study's findings are based on a model derived from experimental data of a small number of individuals with paraplegia, limiting generalizability, and the model may not fully capture biomechanical complexities.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Physiotherapy Educational Intervention for Occipital Positional Plagiocephaly Prevention: a Multicentre Randomised Controlled Trial
items.summary: A multicenter RCT with 400 pregnant women found no statistically significant difference in positional occipital plagiocephaly (POP) prevalence (21.1% vs 22.2%) or oblique diameter difference index at 3 months between a physiotherapy educational intervention group and a control group, though both groups had lower overall POP prevalence than historical data.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心 RCT 挑战了传统面对面产前物理治疗教育在预防体位性斜头畸形（POP）上的优越性。考虑到现有信息渠道多元，你可能需要重新思考 POP 预防宣教的模式和内容，以提高其有效性。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗教育干预预防枕骨体位性斜头畸形：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 400 名孕妇的多中心随机对照试验发现，与对照组相比，接受物理治疗教育干预的产妇所生婴儿在 3 个月时体位性斜头畸形（POP）的患病率（21.1% vs 22.2%）和斜径差异指数均无显著差异，但两组的总体 POP 患病率均低于历史数据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter RCT challenges the superiority of traditional face-to-face prenatal physiotherapy education in preventing positional occipital plagiocephaly (POP). Given the diversity of current information channels, you may need to reconsider the mode and content of POP prevention education to improve its effectiveness.
items.limitation: 研究观察到的POP总发生率远低于文献报道，这可能限制了干预效果的检测能力，且部分数据回顾性注册可能存在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study's observed overall POP prevalence was significantly lower than reported in the literature, which may limit the detectability of intervention effects, and some data were retrospectively registered, potentially introducing bias.

items.title: Fall-prevention education after achieving independent walking is associated with reduced subsequent fall risk in patients with stroke: a retrospective pre-post intervention study.
items.summary: A retrospective pre-post intervention study (n=1,437 stroke patients) found that standardized fall-prevention education delivered after achieving independent walking was associated with a lower adjusted hazard of the first fall (aHR: 0.58, 95% CI: 0.43-0.76, P<.001) and a lower fall incidence rate (IRR: 0.68, 95% CI: 0.51-0.90, P=.006).
items.curatedReason: 中风患者在达到独立行走后立即接受标准化跌倒预防教育，可显著降低后续跌倒风险，并延长首次跌倒时间。将这项结构化教育纳入卒中康复流程，是预防高风险患者跌倒的有效干预。
items.titleZh: 中风患者在达到独立行走后接受跌倒预防教育，可降低后续跌倒风险：一项回顾性干预前后研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性干预前后研究（涉及 1,437 名中风患者）发现，在达到独立行走后立即提供标准化跌倒预防教育，与首次跌倒风险显著降低（调整后 HR: 0.58, 95% CI: 0.43-0.76, P<.001）和跌倒发生率降低（IRR: 0.68, 95% CI: 0.51-0.90, P=.006）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standardized fall-prevention education, delivered immediately after achieving independent walking in stroke patients, significantly reduces subsequent fall risk and prolongs the time to first fall. Incorporating this structured education into stroke rehabilitation protocols is an effective intervention for preventing falls in high-risk patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性设计，存在潜在的选择偏倚和混杂因素，可能影响因果关系的强度。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective study, which may be subject to selection bias and confounding factors, potentially affecting the strength of causal inference.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Is therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention effective in reducing kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=854) found that standalone therapeutic exercise significantly reduced kinesiophobia compared with passive controls and usual care (MD = -5.38; 95% CI -7.63 to -3.13; SMD = -1.03) in adults with NSCLBP, although considerable heterogeneity (I² ≈ 94%) and low certainty of evidence were observed.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述提示，作为单一干预的治疗性运动可能有助于减轻非特异性慢性腰痛患者的运动恐惧症，效应量超过临床最小重要差异。但鉴于证据异质性高且确定性低，在临床实践中仍需结合患者个体情况谨慎应用。
items.titleZh: 治疗性运动作为单一干预是否能有效减轻非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的运动恐惧症？一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 8 项随机对照试验（854 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，与被动控制组和常规护理相比，单一治疗性运动显著降低了非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的运动恐惧症（MD = -5.38; 95% CI -7.63 to -3.13; SMD = -1.03），但研究间存在显著异质性（I² ≈ 94%），且证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review suggests that standalone therapeutic exercise may reduce kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain, with an effect size exceeding the minimal clinically important difference. However, given the high heterogeneity and low certainty of evidence, apply these findings cautiously in clinical practice, considering individual patient context.
items.limitation: 证据确定性低，且研究间存在显著异质性（I² ≈ 94%），限制了结果的普遍性和确定性。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence is low, and significant heterogeneity (I² ≈ 94%) among studies limits the generalizability and certainty of the findings.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Adding the short, digital PainSMART-educational strategy whilst patients with musculoskeletal pain wait for primary care physiotherapy: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: Adding a 7-min pain science education film (PainSMART) to usual physiotherapy for musculoskeletal pain did not result in additional clinically meaningful benefits once physiotherapy commenced, though it may facilitate earlier improvements in MSKP-perceptions and self-efficacy (MD 1.6, 95% CI 0.10 to 3.0) during waiting times.
items.curatedReason: 疼痛科学教育（PainSMART）在患者等待初级物理治疗期间，对疼痛自我效能感有短期提升，但一旦物理治疗开始，其附加的临床意义并不显著。将其作为等待期辅助工具，但别期待它能替代常规治疗。
items.titleZh: 初级物理治疗等待期加入数字疼痛科学教育策略（PainSMART）对肌肉骨骼疼痛患者的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验显示，在患者等待初级物理治疗期间加入 7 分钟的疼痛科学教育策略（PainSMART），一旦物理治疗开始，并未带来额外的临床显著益处。但在等待期，该策略可能促进疼痛感知和自我效能感的早期改善（MD 1.6, 95% CI 0.10 to 3.0）。
items.curatedReasonEn: PainSMART, a pain science education strategy delivered during the waiting period for primary physiotherapy, showed short-term improvements in pain self-efficacy. However, once physiotherapy commenced, its added clinical benefits were not significant. Consider it as a supportive tool during waiting times, but don't expect it to replace conventional therapy.
items.limitation: 该研究关注的主要是急性期效果，且疼痛自我效能感的改善仅为探索性分析结果。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily focused on acute phase effects, and improvements in pain self-efficacy were only exploratory analysis results.

items.title: If ACL injury is multifactorial, why is return-to-sport testing not? A determinant-alignment framework for ACL rehabilitation and return to sport.
items.summary: This Masterclass proposes a determinant-alignment framework for late-stage ACL rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessment, aiming to broaden the focus beyond physical capacity to include perceptual, neurocognitive, contextual, and representative sport demands.
items.curatedReason: ACL 损伤和康复是一个多因素过程，但目前大多数重返运动测试过于聚焦身体能力。这个框架提示你整合知觉、神经认知、情境和专项运动负荷的评估，以更全面地指导康复决策。
items.titleZh: ACL 损伤是多因素的，为何重返运动测试不是？一个面向 ACL 康复和重返运动的决定因素对齐框架
items.summaryZh: 这篇大师课文章提出了一个针对 ACL 康复后期和重返运动评估的决定因素对齐框架，旨在将评估重点从单纯的身体能力扩展到知觉、神经认知、情境和专项运动需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: ACL injury and rehabilitation are multifactorial processes, yet current return-to-sport testing often overemphasizes physical capacity. This framework suggests integrating perceptual, neurocognitive, contextual, and sport-specific load assessments to guide rehabilitation decisions more comprehensively.
items.limitation: 该框架是一个假设生成型的临床启发式模型，并非经过验证的分类法或预测算法，也无证据表明更广泛的评估能降低二次 ACL 损伤风险。
items.limitationEn: This framework is a hypothesis-generating clinical heuristic, not a validated taxonomy or prediction algorithm, and lacks evidence that broader assessment reduces the risk of second ACL injury.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Trajectories of rehabilitation exercise adherence after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a prospective longitudinal study
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal study of 199 older adults after hip fracture surgery identified three trajectories of rehabilitation exercise adherence over 6 months: low (5.53%), moderate (77.89%), and high (16.58%). Higher education, household income, and self-efficacy were associated with higher adherence, while high-intensity rehabilitation plans correlated with lower adherence.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究揭示了髋部骨折术后老年患者运动依从性有三种主要轨迹，其中教育水平、家庭收入和运动自我效能感与高依从性相关。这提示你，除了临床干预，患者的社会经济和心理因素也是康复成功的关键，别只盯着训练本身。
items.titleZh: 老年髋部骨折术后康复运动依从性轨迹：一项前瞻性纵向研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 199 名老年髋部骨折术后患者的前瞻性纵向研究，在术后 6 个月内识别出三种康复运动依从性轨迹：低依从性（5.53%）、中依从性（77.89%）和高依从性（16.58%）。较高的教育水平、家庭收入和自我效能感与高依从性相关，而高强度康复计划反而与较低依从性相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study reveals three main trajectories of exercise adherence in older adults after hip fracture surgery, with higher education, household income, and exercise self-efficacy linked to high adherence. This suggests that socio-economic and psychological factors are critical for rehabilitation success, beyond clinical interventions alone.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心、样本量较小（199 例），且回归分析结论为探索性质，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study is single-center with a relatively small sample size (199 participants), and its regression findings are exploratory, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Sarcopenia, Nutritional Status, and the Association Between Rehabilitation Dose and Functional Efficiency After Inpatient Rehabilitation for First-Ever Ischemic Stroke.
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort of 1,036 ischemic stroke patients found that a higher rehabilitation dose (per 30 min/day, β=0.17), better nutritional status (per 5-point Geriatric Nutritional Risk Index, β=0.05), and absence of sarcopenia (β=-0.22) were associated with higher functional efficiency after inpatient rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性队列研究强调，卒中患者的康复剂量、肌少症和营养状况都会影响其住院康复后的功能效率。临床上，在制定康复计划时，除了关注康复强度，也应把营养筛查和肌少症管理纳入进来，特别是对那些存在肌少症或营养不良风险的患者，可能需要调整康复方案。
items.titleZh: 首次缺血性卒中住院康复后肌少症、营养状况、康复剂量与功能效率之间的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对 1,036 例首次缺血性卒中患者的单中心回顾性队列研究发现，更高的康复剂量（每增加 30 分钟/天，β=0.17）、更好的营养状况（老年营养风险指数每增加 5 分，β=0.05）以及无肌少症（β=-0.22）都与住院康复后的更高功能效率相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective cohort study highlights that rehabilitation dose, sarcopenia, and nutritional status all influence functional efficiency after inpatient stroke rehabilitation. Clinically, when planning rehabilitation, consider nutritional screening and sarcopenia management alongside rehabilitation intensity, especially for patients at risk of sarcopenia or malnutrition, who may require tailored rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性观察研究，存在选择偏倚风险，且其发现的关联性不能直接推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective observational study, subject to selection bias, and the associations found cannot directly infer causation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of ankle-foot orthosis-related conditions on muscle activity, spasticity, and psychosocial outcomes after stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 studies (931 participants) found that ankle-foot orthosis (AFO)-related conditions were associated with reduced lower-limb EMG activity (SMD = -0.40) and spasticity (SMD = -0.41) after stroke, but showed no significant effect on psychosocial outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了踝足矫形器（AFO）能有效降低卒中后下肢肌电活动和痉挛，效应量中等。这对你选择康复策略有直接依据，尤其当目标是改善步态稳定性时。
items.titleZh: 踝足矫形器相关条件对卒中后肌肉活动、痉挛和心理社会结局的影响：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 10 项研究（931 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析显示，卒中后使用踝足矫形器（AFO）与下肢肌电活动（SMD = -0.40）和痉挛（SMD = -0.41）降低相关，但对心理社会结局无显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms that AFOs can effectively reduce lower-limb EMG activity and spasticity post-stroke, with moderate effect sizes. This provides direct evidence for your rehabilitation strategy, especially when aiming to improve gait stability.
items.limitation: 研究未发现踝足矫形器对患者心理社会结局有显著影响，这部分仍待进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The review found no significant effect of AFOs on psychosocial outcomes, which remains an area for further investigation.

items.title: Exploring the experience of time-restricted eating in veterans with spinal cord injury and obesity: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the experiences of 14 veterans with spinal cord injury (SCI) and obesity participating in time-restricted eating (TRE), identifying motives, participation experiences, perceived health changes, and unique barriers and facilitators such as medication management and routine consistency.
items.curatedReason: 如果你手上有 SCI 合并肥胖的患者想尝试限时进食 (TRE)，这项研究提示，他们可能会面临药物和排便管理等独特挑战，以及对规律作息的高度依赖。虽然是小样本定性研究，但它为这类患者提供了初步的用户视角，值得我们在临床实践中予以关注。
items.titleZh: 探究脊髓损伤合并肥胖退伍军人限时进食体验的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 14 名脊髓损伤 (SCI) 合并肥胖的退伍军人参与限时进食 (TRE) 的体验，识别了其动机、参与体验、感知到的健康变化，以及独特的障碍（如药物管理）和促进因素（如规律作息）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with SCI and obesity considering time-restricted eating (TRE), this study suggests they may encounter unique challenges like medication and bowel management, and a strong reliance on consistent routines. While a small qualitative study, it offers an initial patient perspective on TRE in this population, which clinicians should note.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本定性研究，结果的普适性有限，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample qualitative study with limited generalizability, and potential for recall bias.

items.title: A Valid and Reliable Virtual Reality Tool for Assessment of Arm Nonuse Post-Stroke
items.summary: A novel virtual reality (VR-NonUse) tool demonstrated reliability, validity, and usability in assessing paretic arm nonuse in 51 individuals post-stroke, showing stronger associations with established nonuse measures than with motor impairment.
items.curatedReason: 针对卒中后偏瘫手臂非使用，这项研究提示我们，新的 VR-NonUse 工具在评估信效度上表现良好。它能更好地反映“非使用”本身，而非单纯的运动障碍，这有助于你区分纯运动受限和患者刻意不使用手臂的情况。
items.titleZh: 一种有效且可靠的虚拟现实工具，用于评估卒中后手臂非使用
items.summaryZh: 一项新颖的虚拟现实（VR-NonUse）工具在评估 51 名卒中后患者患侧手臂非使用方面表现出良好的可靠性、有效性和可用性，与现有非使用评估工具的相关性更强。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests a new VR-NonUse tool shows promising reliability and validity for assessing paretic arm nonuse post-stroke. Importantly, it correlates more strongly with established nonuse measures than with motor impairment, helping you differentiate between true motor deficits and learned nonuse.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性验证研究，需在更大范围和多样化人群中进一步验证其长期预测价值和对治疗干预的指导作用。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory validation study, and its long-term predictive value and guidance for therapeutic interventions need further validation in larger, more diverse populations.

items.title: Feasibility and efficacy of personalized cardiorespiratory and strength exercise in Duchenne muscular dystrophy: a pilot study
items.summary: A pilot study with six ambulatory boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy showed personalized home-based, remotely-supervised leg cycling and isometric strengthening was feasible and safe over 6 months, improving peak VO2 and submaximal-cycling HR, and increasing CSA relative to controls.
items.curatedReason: DMD 患者的个性化有氧与力量训练是安全且可行的。这项初步研究提示，早期、定制化的干预能改善心肺功能和肌肉质量，支持将其作为常规治疗的补充手段。
items.titleZh: 杜氏肌营养不良症患者个性化心肺和力量训练的可行性与有效性：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对六名可步行杜氏肌营养不良症男孩的初步研究显示，为期 6 个月的个性化居家远程监督下肢骑行和等长力量训练安全可行，可改善峰值摄氧量和次最大运动心率，并相对于对照组增加肌肉横截面积。
items.curatedReasonEn: Personalized cardiorespiratory and strength training is safe and feasible for DMD patients. This pilot study suggests that early, tailored interventions can improve cardiorespiratory fitness and muscle mass, supporting its role as a complementary therapeutic strategy.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步可行性研究，所有数据来自六名受试者，尚需大规模RCT验证长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample pilot feasibility study, with data from only six participants; large-scale RCTs are needed to validate long-term efficacy.

items.title: Therapists' perspectives on the use of an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions for minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy: a qualitative study
items.summary: A qualitative study explored therapists' perspectives on using an overground lower-limb exoskeleton for minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy, finding it a valuable adjunct to conventional therapy but requiring new skills and resources, and highlighting considerations for clinical implementation.
items.curatedReason: 对于重度脑瘫儿童，下肢外骨骼训练被视为常规物理治疗的有益补充，而非替代。了解治疗师的使用体验和面临的资源挑战，有助于诊所评估其潜在价值和实际操作问题。
items.titleZh: 治疗师视角下的地面前行下肢外骨骼在微步行脑瘫儿童物理治疗中的应用：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了治疗师对在微步行脑瘫儿童物理治疗中使用地面前行下肢外骨骼的看法，发现其是常规治疗的宝贵辅助手段，但需要新技能和资源，并强调了临床实施中的考量因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy, lower-limb exoskeleton training is viewed as a beneficial adjunct to conventional physical therapy, not a replacement. Understanding therapists' experiences and resource challenges helps clinics assess its potential value and practical implementation issues.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小且基于治疗师的感知，结果可能不具备广泛代表性，且未直接评估患儿的临床结局改善。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size based on therapists' perceptions; results may not be broadly representative and did not directly assess clinical outcome improvements in children.

items.title: Proprioception Training and Surrogate Outcomes: A Systematic Review of Definitions, Measures, and Effectiveness Claims.
items.summary: A systematic review of 51 randomized controlled trials (n=2319) found that while multimodal regimens often improved surrogate outcomes (balance, pain, strength), direct psychophysical proprioceptive function was consistently enhanced only when training explicitly targeted the measured sensory construct. Improvements inferred from surrogate outcomes were more frequent and often larger than those in direct psychophysical measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，要真正改善本体感觉，训练必须直接针对特定的感觉结构，而不是依赖平衡、力量或疼痛等替代指标。这促使你重新审视本体感觉训练方案，优先选择心理物理学结局验证过的干预。
items.titleZh: 本体感觉训练与替代结局：一项关于定义、测量和有效性声明的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 51 项随机对照试验（n=2319）的系统综述发现，尽管多模式方案通常能改善替代结局（平衡、疼痛、力量），但只有当训练明确针对所测量的感觉结构时，直接的心理物理学本体感觉功能才能得到持续增强。从替代结局推断的改善比直接心理物理学测量观察到的改善更频繁且幅度更大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clarifies that to truly improve proprioception, training must directly target specific sensory constructs, rather than relying on surrogate outcomes like balance, strength, or pain. This should prompt you to re-evaluate proprioceptive training protocols, prioritizing interventions validated by psychophysical outcomes.
items.limitation: 纳入的 RCT 在本体感觉的定义、测量方法和效果声明上存在异质性，可能影响结果的综合解释。
items.limitationEn: The included RCTs exhibited heterogeneity in proprioception definitions, measurement approaches, and effectiveness claims, potentially affecting the synthesis and interpretation of results.

items.title: Cost-utility of non-pharmacologic interventions aimed at improving cognitive outcomes after traumatic brain injury in older adulthood from the Ontario public healthcare payer perspective
items.summary: A cost-utility analysis in Ontario, Canada, comparing non-pharmacologic interventions for older adults (≥ 65 years) post-TBI, found that combination therapy (physical rehabilitation and cognitive training) yielded the highest QALYs (3.04 QALYs) and net monetary benefit (CAD$102,653), with an ICER of CAD$18,028 per QALY gained.
items.curatedReason: 这项成本效益分析明确指出，在加拿大安大略省的公共医疗体系下，针对老年创伤性脑损伤（TBI）患者，结合物理康复和认知训练的干预措施最具成本效益，显著提高了 QALYs 并降低了痴呆发生率。这意味着在资源有限的环境中，组合疗法应成为你优化 TBI 老年患者认知结局的首选策略。
items.titleZh: 从安大略省公共医疗支付方视角看，旨在改善老年创伤性脑损伤后认知结局的非药物干预措施的成本效益
items.summaryZh: 一项在加拿大安大略省进行的成本效益分析显示，针对老年（≥ 65 岁）TBI 患者的非药物干预中，结合物理康复和认知训练的组合疗法产生了最高的质量调整生命年（3.04 QALYs）和净货币收益（CAD$102,653），增量成本效益比为 CAD$18,028/QALY。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cost-utility analysis clearly indicates that for older adults with traumatic brain injury (TBI) within Ontario, Canada's public healthcare system, combined physical rehabilitation and cognitive training is the most cost-effective intervention, significantly improving QALYs and reducing dementia incidence. This means that in resource-constrained settings, combination therapy should be your preferred strategy for optimizing cognitive outcomes in older TBI patients.
items.limitation: 该研究的成本效益分析结果特定于加拿大安大略省的公共医疗支付方视角，其经济参数和阈值可能不适用于其他医疗系统。
items.limitationEn: The cost-utility analysis results are specific to the Ontario public healthcare payer perspective, and its economic parameters and thresholds may not be applicable to other healthcare systems.

items.title: Exercise snacking as a novel strategy for prevention and intervention of frailty in older adults: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review on "exercise snacking" as a novel strategy for preventing and intervening in frailty in older adults found promising potential, particularly given the unsuitability of conventional long-duration exercise for this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述表明，对老年人来说，将零星运动（exercise snacking）作为预防和干预衰弱的新策略是可行的。考虑到传统长时间运动对老年人的挑战，你应该开始探索如何将这种短时、高频的运动模式融入你的老年患者康复方案，以提高依从性和效果。
items.titleZh: 零星运动作为预防和干预老年人衰弱的新策略：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于“零星运动”作为预防和干预老年人衰弱新策略的范围综述发现其具有广阔潜力，尤其考虑到传统长时间运动对老年人往往不适用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that 'exercise snacking' is a viable new strategy for frailty prevention and intervention in older adults. Given the challenges older adults face with traditional long-duration exercise, you should explore integrating these short, frequent bursts of activity into your geriatric rehabilitation programs to improve adherence and outcomes.
items.limitation: 该范围综述主要基于对中年和青年人的研究，专门针对老年衰弱的证据仍然缺乏，需要更多老年人群的直接研究。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review is largely based on studies in middle-aged and young adults, with direct evidence specifically addressing frailty in older adults still lacking, necessitating more direct research in this population.

items.title: Centering First Nations parents' voices: a community-directed pediatric rehabilitation needs assessment in Northern Saskatchewan.
items.summary: A community-based participatory action research study in Northern Saskatchewan found that First Nations parents face significant barriers in accessing pediatric rehabilitation services due to an inequitable healthcare system, recommending a shift towards strength-based, family-centered, culturally grounded, and community-led care.
items.curatedReason: 这项社区导向的研究揭示了加拿大原住民儿童康复服务中存在的严重系统性不平等，包括信息匮乏、服务延迟和资源不足。这要求我们重新审视现有评估框架，转向以家庭为中心、文化为基础的康复模式，避免沿用西方医学模式的偏见。
items.titleZh: 以原住民父母之声为中心：萨斯喀彻温省北部社区导向的儿童康复需求评估
items.summaryZh: 一项加拿大萨斯喀彻温省北部社区参与式行动研究发现，原住民父母因医疗系统不平等，在获取儿科康复服务方面面临重大障碍，建议转向以优势为基础、家庭为中心、文化为根基、社区主导的护理模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This community-directed study highlights severe systemic inequities in pediatric rehabilitation services for Indigenous children in Northern Saskatchewan, including lack of information, service delays, and insufficient resources. It mandates a critical re-evaluation of existing frameworks towards family-centered, culturally grounded rehabilitation, moving away from biases inherent in Western medical models.
items.limitation: 该研究基于定性访谈，未量化服务差距，且结果特异于加拿大北部原住民社区，推广性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on qualitative interviews, does not quantify service gaps, and its findings are specific to Northern Saskatchewan Indigenous communities, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Comparative changes in cardiovascular measures following speed, agility, and quickness training and small-sided games in youth football players: a randomized trial
items.summary: A randomized trial compared the cardiovascular measures following speed, agility, and quickness (SAQ) training and small-sided games (SSGs) in youth football players, investigating their differential physical and football-specific demands.
items.curatedReason: 对于青少年足球运动员，这项研究证实 SAQ 训练和小型比赛（SSG）在心血管负荷上存在差异。这意味着在设计体能和康复计划时，应根据训练目标更精细地选择 SAQ 或 SSG，以实现特定的生理适应。
items.titleZh: 青少年足球运动员速度、敏捷性、快速性训练与小型比赛后心血管指标的比较性变化：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机试验比较了青少年足球运动员在速度、敏捷性、快速性（SAQ）训练和小型比赛（SSGs）后心血管指标的变化，旨在研究它们在身体和足球特定需求上的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For youth football players, this RCT confirms distinct cardiovascular loads between SAQ training and small-sided games (SSG). When designing conditioning or rehab programs, you should meticulously choose between SAQ and SSG based on your specific training objectives to elicit desired physiological adaptations.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供具体的关键效应量或统计数据，仅提及比较性变化，限制了对其临床意义的解读。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide specific key effect sizes or statistical data, only mentioning comparative changes, which limits the interpretation of its clinical significance.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Biological effects of technique-specific manual therapy in healthy individuals and people with musculoskeletal disorders: a systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 50 studies (2,147 participants) found that manual therapy induces short-term neurophysiological modulation with technique-specific responses. Joint mobilization significantly increased skin conductance (sympathetic marker) versus sham in healthy cohorts, while non-HVLA soft tissue techniques were associated with reduced heart rate and increased RMSSD (parasympathetic marker).
items.curatedReason: 手法治疗确实能即刻影响神经生理，但要分清楚：关节松动术主要激活交感神经（皮肤电导增加），而软组织技术则更倾向于激活副交感神经（心率降低，RMSSD 增加）。所以，别再把所有手法一概而论了，你的技术选择应与你希望引发的自主神经反应相匹配。
items.titleZh: 技术特异性手法治疗对健康个体和肌肉骨骼疾病患者的生物学效应：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 50 项研究（2,147 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，手法治疗能够短期调节神经生理反应，且存在技术特异性效应。在健康人群中，关节松动术显著增加了皮肤电导（交感神经标志物），而非高低速（non-HVLA）软组织技术则与心率降低和 RMSSD 升高（副交感神经标志物）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Manual therapy does induce immediate neurophysiological changes, but specific techniques matter: joint mobilization primarily elicits sympathetic responses (increased skin conductance), while non-HVLA soft tissue techniques lean towards parasympathetic activation (reduced heart rate, increased RMSSD). Stop lumping all manual therapies together; align your technique choice with your desired autonomic nervous system response.
items.limitation: 证据确定性为低到中等，主要由于方法学异质性和不精确性。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence ranged from low to moderate, mainly due to methodological heterogeneity and imprecision.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Developing biopsychosocial competence in musculoskeletal pain care: Australian physiotherapy educators' perspectives.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 18 Australian physiotherapy educators identified five themes, or 'translation levers,' crucial for developing biopsychosocial competence and facilitating its clinical adoption in musculoskeletal pain care.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究深入探讨了澳大利亚物理治疗教育者如何教授生物心理社会模型，识别出支持该模型临床转化的具体工具、结构和流程。这为你理解和改进教学策略提供了实践框架。
items.titleZh: 培养肌肉骨骼疼痛护理中的生物心理社会能力：澳大利亚物理治疗教育者的视角
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 18 名澳大利亚物理治疗教育者的定性研究确定了五个主题，即“转化杠杆”，这些主题对于培养生物心理社会能力并促进其在肌肉骨骼疼痛护理中的临床应用至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study explores how Australian physiotherapy educators teach the biopsychosocial model, identifying specific tools, structures, and processes that support its clinical translation. It offers a practical framework for understanding and improving your teaching strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小且局限于澳大利亚教育者的视角，其发现的转化杠杆需要在更广泛的背景下进行验证。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative exploratory study has a small sample size and is limited to the perspectives of Australian educators, meaning the identified translation levers require validation in broader contexts.

items.title: The Impact of Upper Extremity Rehabilitation on Fatigue in Individuals With Multiple Sclerosis: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of nine studies (n=250) on upper extremity rehabilitation for fatigue in PwMS found insufficient evidence to draw definitive conclusions, with low to very low certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 该系统综述表明，当前关于上肢康复对多发性硬化症患者疲劳影响的证据仍然不足，尽管研究了多种技术辅助和运动干预。在缺乏高质量证据的情况下，不要将上肢康复作为减轻疲劳的独立干预措施。
items.titleZh: 上肢康复对多发性硬化症患者疲劳影响的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对多发性硬化症患者疲劳上肢康复的九项研究（n=250）的系统综述发现，现有证据不足以得出明确结论，且证据确定性为低至非常低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review indicates that current evidence on the effects of upper extremity rehabilitation on fatigue in PwMS is insufficient, despite various technology-assisted and exercise-based interventions. Avoid positioning upper extremity rehabilitation as a standalone intervention for fatigue given the lack of high-quality evidence.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的证据确定性低至非常低，且异质性高，限制了得出明确结论的能力。
items.limitationEn: The included studies exhibit low to very low certainty of evidence and high heterogeneity, limiting the ability to draw definitive conclusions.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: The Effect of Robot-Assisted Gait Training on Balance, Gait and Kinesiophobia in Individuals With Post-Stroke Hemiparesis: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blind, parallel-group RCT (n=60) found that adding robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) to conventional rehabilitation significantly improved balance, gait, walking speed, balance confidence, and kinesiophobia in individuals with post-stroke hemiparesis, with a between-group difference in KCS total score of -0.36 (95% CI: -0.51 to -0.21).
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证明，在常规康复中加入机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）能显著改善卒中后偏瘫患者的平衡、步态、步行速度以及运动恐惧症。这些发现支持了 RAGT 的附加益处，但在比较干预效果时，请记住总治疗暴露量增加的局限性。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练对卒中后偏瘫患者平衡、步态和运动恐惧症的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲、平行组随机对照试验（n=60）发现，在常规康复中加入机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）能显著改善卒中后偏瘫患者的平衡、步态、步行速度、平衡信心和运动恐惧症，KCS 总分组间差异为 -0.36（95% CI：-0.51 至 -0.21）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that adding robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) to conventional rehabilitation significantly improves balance, gait, walking speed, and kinesiophobia in individuals with post-stroke hemiparesis. These findings support the additional benefits of RAGT, but remember the limitation of increased overall treatment exposure when comparing intervention effects.
items.limitation: 研究观察到的组间差异可能部分归因于 RAGT 组获得了更大的总体治疗暴露量，而不仅仅是机器人组件本身的效果。
items.limitationEn: Observed between-group differences may be partially attributable to the RAGT group receiving greater overall treatment exposure, not solely the robotic component.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Manual Lymph Drainage in Lower Extremity Lymphedema Management: An Essential Component or An Optional Extra? A Single-Blind, Randomized Non-Inferiority Trial
items.summary: This single-blind, randomized non-inferiority trial aims to determine if compression bandaging alone is non-inferior to compression bandaging combined with manual lymphatic drainage for reducing limb volume, tissue stiffness, and skin/subcutaneous thickness in Stage 2–3 lower extremity lymphedema.
items.curatedReason: 这项非劣效性试验旨在评估单独使用加压包扎是否不劣于结合手工淋巴引流（MLD）的治疗。其结果将直接影响你在一期和二期下肢淋巴水肿治疗中 MLD 的常规使用，判断其是否为核心要素。
items.titleZh: 下肢淋巴水肿管理中的手工淋巴引流：核心组成部分还是可选附加项？一项单盲、随机非劣效性试验
items.summaryZh: 这项单盲、随机非劣效性试验旨在确定单独使用加压包扎在减少二期至三期下肢淋巴水肿（LEL）的肢体体积、组织硬度和皮肤/皮下厚度方面，是否不劣于结合手工淋巴引流（MLD）的加压包扎。
items.curatedReasonEn: This non-inferiority trial aims to assess whether compression bandaging alone is non-inferior to CB combined with MLD. Its results will directly impact your routine use of MLD in intensive phase treatment for Stage 2-3 lower extremity lymphedema, determining if it is an essential component.
items.limitation: 由于这是对非劣效性的评估，研究结果的临床意义将取决于设定的非劣效性界值是否足够小以反映实际临床差异。
items.limitationEn: As this is an assessment of non-inferiority, the clinical relevance of the results will depend on whether the set non-inferiority margin is sufficiently small to reflect a true clinical difference.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Comparison of action observation therapy and virtual reality combined with conventional therapy for upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy.
items.summary: This RCT (n=45) found that both action observation therapy and virtual reality (XBOX Kinect) combined with conventional physiotherapy improved upper extremity function and participation more than conventional therapy alone in children with unilateral cerebral palsy.
items.curatedReason: 对于单侧脑瘫儿童的上肢康复，动作观察疗法（AOT）和虚拟现实（XBOX）均显示出优于传统疗法的效果。在考虑辅助治疗方案时，可以纳入这两种方法，尤其是在精细抓握和选择性控制方面，AOT 可能提供更全面的改善。
items.titleZh: 动作观察疗法与虚拟现实结合常规疗法在单侧脑瘫儿童上肢康复中的比较
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=45）发现，在单侧脑瘫儿童的上肢康复中，动作观察疗法和虚拟现实（XBOX Kinect）结合常规物理治疗，在改善上肢功能和参与度方面均优于单纯的常规治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: For upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy, both action observation therapy (AOT) and virtual reality (XBOX) showed superior effects compared to conventional therapy. When considering supplementary treatment options, these two methods can be included, with AOT potentially offering more comprehensive improvements, especially in fine grasp and selective control.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=45），随访时间较短（3周）。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=45) and a short follow-up period (3 weeks).

items.title: Scar dry needling for tissue compliance in individuals with linear scars: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: This RCT (n=80) compared scar dry needling (DN) with minimal needling, finding that scar-DN was associated with short-term improvements in tissue compliance at some indentation depths, but no significant differences in local scar-related pain or health-related quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 干针在疤痕管理中的证据尚有限，但这项研究提示它能在短期内改善线性疤痕的组织柔顺性。虽然疼痛和生活质量未见显著改善，但组织力学变化本身值得我们继续关注其长期临床价值和适用边界。
items.titleZh: 线性疤痕个体干针治疗对组织柔顺性的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=80）比较了疤痕干针（DN）与微量针刺，发现疤痕干针在某些压痕深度上与短期组织柔顺性改善相关，但在局部疤痕相关疼痛或健康相关生活质量方面未见显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for dry needling in scar management is limited, but this study suggests it can improve tissue compliance in linear scars short-term. While no significant improvements in pain or quality of life were observed, the mechanical changes in tissue warrant continued attention to its long-term clinical value and application boundaries.
items.limitation: 研究未能发现干针在疤痕相关疼痛或健康相关生活质量方面的显著改善，且部分分析（如被动膝关节屈曲）样本量过小，限制了结论的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not find significant improvements in scar-related pain or health-related quality of life with dry needling, and some analyses (e.g., passive knee flexion) had very small sample sizes, limiting the generalizability of conclusions.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Effects of a Cycling-Based Aerobic Exercise Program Versus a Resistance and Neuromuscular Exercise Program on Exercise-Induced Hypoalgesia in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Study Protocol for a Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: This study protocol outlines a randomized controlled trial (n=90) to compare the effects of a cycling-based aerobic exercise program versus a resistance and neuromuscular exercise program on exercise-induced hypoalgesia (EIH) in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项研究方案，并非实际结果，所以现在改变你的临床实践还为时过早。但如果这项纳入 90 人的 RCT 最终显示，骑行或其他有氧运动在改善膝骨关节炎患者运动诱发痛觉减退（EIH）方面优于传统阻抗和神经肌肉训练，那么它将挑战我们目前对运动处方的固有认知。
items.titleZh: 循环式有氧运动与抗阻及神经肌肉运动对膝骨关节炎患者运动诱发痛觉减退影响的研究方案：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 这项研究方案描述了一项随机对照试验（n=90），旨在比较循环式有氧运动方案与抗阻及神经肌肉运动方案对膝骨关节炎患者运动诱发痛觉减退（EIH）的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a study protocol, not actual results, so it's premature to change your clinical practice. However, if this n=90 RCT ultimately demonstrates that cycling or other aerobic exercise is superior to traditional resistance and neuromuscular training in improving exercise-induced hypoalgesia (EIH) in knee OA patients, it will challenge our current understanding of exercise prescription.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未有实际结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and actual results are not yet available.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Gait Speed Changes in Stroke Rehabilitation Motor Lower Extremity Randomized Controlled Trials by Intervention and Time Post-Stroke: A Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A meta-analysis of 106 RCTs found that motor lower extremity stroke rehabilitation interventions in the acute/subacute phases demonstrated significantly greater magnitude of improvement in gait speed compared to those in the chronic phase, with treadmill training, body weight-supported treadmill training, and exoskeletons showing significant benefits acutely.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后下肢运动康复，请务必在急性/亚急性期介入，因为对步速改善的效应量远大于慢性期。其中，跑步机训练、体位支持跑步机训练和外骨骼在急性期都有显著益处。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复下肢运动随机对照试验中步速变化：干预手段与卒中后时间的荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖106项随机对照试验的荟萃分析发现，卒中后下肢运动康复干预在急性/亚急性期对步速改善的效应量显著大于慢性期，其中跑步机训练、体位支持跑步机训练和外骨骼在急性期显示出显著益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: For post-stroke lower extremity motor rehabilitation, prioritize intervention in the acute/subacute phases, as the effect size for gait speed improvement is significantly greater than in the chronic phase. Treadmill training, body weight-supported treadmill training, and exoskeletons all show significant benefits acutely.
items.limitation: 尽管分析涵盖了大量RCT，但不同干预措施在研究方法、患者异质性及结果测量上的差异，可能影响了荟萃分析的总体解释力。
items.limitationEn: Although the analysis included a large number of RCTs, variations in research methods, patient heterogeneity, and outcome measures across different interventions may affect the overall interpretability of the meta-analysis.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of Virtual Reality-Assisted Task-Oriented Training on Clinical and Psychosocial Outcomes in Individuals with Rotator Cuff Tears: A Randomized Controlled Single-Blind Trial.
items.summary: Adding virtual reality-assisted task-oriented training (VR-TOT) to conventional physiotherapy in individuals with partial rotator cuff tears significantly improved upper extremity function (DASH mean difference -3.93 points), pain, shoulder-related disability, kinesiophobia, and pain catastrophizing in the short term, though the DASH difference did not reach MCID.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于部分肩袖撕裂，常规物理治疗中加入虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练，可在短期内进一步改善上肢功能、疼痛和运动恐惧，但功能改善的效应量未达临床最小重要差异。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练对肩袖撕裂患者临床与心理社会结局的影响：一项随机对照单盲试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照单盲试验显示，对于部分肩袖撕裂患者，在常规物理治疗中加入虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练，可显著改善上肢功能（DASH 平均差异 -3.93 点）、疼痛、肩关节相关残疾、运动恐惧和疼痛灾难化，但DASH的改善量未达到临床最小重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that adding virtual reality-assisted task-oriented training to conventional physiotherapy for partial rotator cuff tears can further improve upper extremity function, pain, and kinesiophobia in the short term. However, the effect size for functional improvement did not reach the minimally clinically important difference.
items.limitation: 该研究的DASH功能改善虽具统计学意义，但未达到已发表的临床最小重要差异（MCID），且随访期较短。
items.limitationEn: Although statistically significant, the improvement in DASH scores in this study did not reach the published Minimally Clinically Important Difference (MCID), and the follow-up period was short.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
